meta.title: Become a Founding Member | Puntr
meta.description: Join Puntr’s founding community. The first 100 members receive a permanent numbered badge and free access. Build a transparent sports prediction record from day one. 18+.
meta.ogTitle: Puntr: Predict what's next. Prove your worth.

lead: A new standard for sports predictions starts with the community.
body: Be among the first 100 members to help shape Puntr. Claim your permanent numbered Founding badge and get access at no cost. No card needed. Puntr launches on {{launch}}.

perks.title: Your Founding Member benefits
perks.f1: A permanent Founding badge, numbered #1 to #100
perks.f2: Full access to posting, your record and the weekly leaderboard from launch on 1 December 2026
perks.f3: 30 free Pay-As-You-Go credits a month for 3 months once they launch

s1.title: Join free
s1.body: Create your account with your email and confirm it with the code we send you. You must be 18 or older.

s2.title: Back your call
s2.body: From launch on 1 December 2026, post picks on upcoming football matches before kick-off. Each pick is locked and cannot be edited or deleted.

s3.title: Build a public record
s3.body: Picks will be graded automatically, so your record speaks for you.

fine: Puntr is a sports prediction community, not a bookmaker. Founding Membership is free and limited to the first 100 members.

last.title: Be part of what's next
last.body: The first 100 places are the only opportunity to receive a permanent numbered Founding badge.

pass.title: Founding Annual Pass
pass.body: 12 months of Puntr Pro for a once-off R299 (standard Pro is R99 a month, R1,188 a year). Open to the first {{spots}} founding members who reserve it before {{deadline}}. Your 12 months start on launch day, 1 December 2026, and it does not renew automatically.
pass.note: Reserving is free on Puntr. We email you a secure PayFast payment link. Complete the R299 payment within 48 hours or your reservation expires and the place is released.
pass.emailNotConfigured: Reservations are temporarily unavailable. Please contact support@puntr.co.za.
pass.emailFailed: Your place is held, but we could not send the payment email. Tap below to try again or contact support@puntr.co.za.
pass.missingEmail: We could not find an email address for your account. Update your account details and try again.
pass.emailSent: Payment instructions sent. Pay by {{until}} (South African time).
pass.pending: Your place is reserved until {{until}}. Check your inbox for the secure PayFast payment link and pay within 48 hours.
pass.paid: Paid. Your Founding Annual Pass starts on 1 December 2026.
pass.error: We couldn't start your claim just now. Please try again.
pass.onboardingTitle: One more thing: the Founding Annual Pass
pass.teaser: Founding Members can reserve one of just 20 Annual Passes: 12 months of Puntr Pro for R299 once-off instead of R1,188 at the standard monthly rate. Reserve free on Puntr, then pay through the secure PayFast link emailed to you within 48 hours.

trust.t1: Free to join. No card needed.
trust.t3: Built in South Africa for football fans

faq.title: Quick answers
faq.a1: Yes. Joining is free and you don't need a card. The first 100 members get the numbered Founding badge.
faq.a2: No. Puntr is a prediction community. You post picks and build a public record. We don't take bets.
faq.a3: Puntr launches officially on {{launch}}. Founding Members sign up now, get their numbered badge as soon as they confirm their email, and are first in when we launch.
faq.a4: Anyone in South Africa who is 18 or older. You confirm your email before you can sign in.
